richiami.difetto: The Anti - Roll Bar chassis mounting bracket may fail allowing the Anti - Roll Bar to become insecure
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace chassis mounting bracket with modified type.

richiami.difetto: The drivers side window may shatter
richiami.rimedio: Fit additional support/anti vibration rubbers to the side window.

richiami.difetto: Following several fire related incidents the manufacturer has decided to implement a number of precautionary modifications.
richiami.rimedio: 1)  Relocate exhaust heat shield and remove foam from beneath silencer.  2)  Reloacate the retarder relay box.  3)  Modify the retarder control system to prevent misuse and consequential overheating.  4)  Review the routing of all electrical wiring in and adjacent to the engine bay.  5)  Install an engine bay temperature warning device or an auxiliary cooling fan.  6)  Fit twin alternators on request.  7)  Modify the air pipe between the compressor and the air dryer.

richiami.difetto: Engine alternator may overheat and catch fire.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the single Neihoff alternator with twin Bosch alternators.
